pages.text: Upgrades are items that can be inserted into various Refined Storage machines to enhance their functionality. Each machine has specific upgrade slots that can accept different types of upgrades.

Available upgrade types:$(li)Speed Upgrade - Increases machine processing speed$(li)Stack Upgrade - Increases item transfer amounts$(li)Range Upgrade - Increases wireless range$(li)Crafting Upgrade - Enables autocrafting$(li)Regulator Upgrade - Controls item flow$(li)Fortune Upgrade - Increases fortune level$(li)Silk Touch Upgrade - Enables silk touch$(li)Interdimensional Upgrade - Enables interdimensional access

To use upgrades:$(li)Right-click on a machine to open its interface$(li)Insert upgrades into the upgrade slots$(li)Some upgrades can be stacked for greater effect$(li)Different machines support different upgrade types
